### Targeting the specific extreacted values


```python
for key, value in properties.items(): # .items is important to have
    if key in roads_keys:
        print(f"{key.title()}: {value.title()}.")
```

    Designation: National_Tertiary_Road.
    Lanes: 2.
    Maxspeed: 40.
    Name: F. B. Harrison Street.
    Width: 9.



```python

features = data["features"]

# collect all coords from all features (LineString case)
all_latlon = []
for f in features:
    geom = f["geometry"]
    for lon, lat in geom["coordinates"]:
        all_latlon.append((lat, lon))

center = all_latlon[len(all_latlon)//2]

m = folium.Map(location=center, zoom_start=13, tiles="OpenStreetMap")

for f in features:
    geom = f["geometry"]
    latlon = [(lat, lon) for lon, lat in geom["coordinates"]]
    folium.PolyLine(latlon, color="blue", weight=3, opacity=0.8).add_to(m)

m

```
